critic_risk_flags: SEIHR with H-only observation increases state/parameter complexity in a short single-season window and is explicitly flagged as weakly identifiable in the surveillance risk note. For high-peak series, the added H dynamics can trade off with I/E timing and overfit peak width/height, creating unstable fits across splits. Given delayed_I is already plausible, an explicit H compartment is less justified at this stage.
